==Description==
'''Hidden Enemies''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that only appears in [[Challenge Trials]], after [[Committed]] and before [[Broke]]. When a [[Challenge Trials|Challenge Trial]] with this modifier is beaten, it will be unlocked for the player to apply on any match.

==Effects==
When applied, enemies will become [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] after Wave 5, meaning towers need hidden detection to detect the enemies.
